title: NTSB Details the Miami Crash, Delta's Scary Descent, and American Kills First Class (Sort Of)
summary: NTSB briefs reporters on the fatal Prime Air 767 crash we covered yesterday, and it's grim. A Delta 737 makes an emergency dive from 35,000 feet after a depressurization scare over the Mojave. Plus, American Airlines is killing off its actual first class cabin while still honoring $250,000 lifetime passes for it, and Delta keeps quietly abandoning JFK even as Frontier heads for the exit entirely.
